To specify a local wheel file to install in your `requirements.txt` file, you can use the following format:

`-f path/to/your/local/wheelfile.whl`

For example:

`-f /path/to/my/local/pandas-1.3.5-py3-none-any.whl pandas==1.3.5`

This tells pip to install the `pandas` package from the specified local wheel file, rather than downloading it from PyPI.

Note that you can also specify multiple packages and their corresponding local wheel files in a single `requirements.txt` file, as long as each line follows this format.
